lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the branchial slits. The centroids are distributed with approximately 2.5 diameters of spacing between nodes along the longitudinal and vertical axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect at the high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the dorsal-lateral surface, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient showing high-reflectance upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation or notch on the posterior margin of the fifth branchial slit (indicated by a gray arrow). A distinct semicircular notch or tissue loss on the posterior distal margin of the right pectoral fin (indicated by a white arrow).
